classification.difficultyReason: Model the ladder and wall as a right triangle and locate the given angle at the wall; use cosine for the adjacent wall height and sine for the opposite base distance, then round.

content.prompt: A ladder of length 4 m is leaning against a wall so that the top of the ladder is at the top of the wall. If the ladder makes an angle of $7^\circ$ with the wall, find, correct to the nearest centimetre:

answer.worked:
Let the wall height be $h$ metres. Relative to the angle at the wall, $h$ is adjacent and the ladder is the hypotenuse.
$$\begin{align*}\cos7^\circ&=\frac{h}{4}\\h&=4\cos7^\circ\\h&\approx3.97\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: how far the base of the ladder is from the wall

answer.worked:
Let the distance from the wall be $d$ metres. It is opposite the $7^\circ$ angle.
$$\begin{align*}\sin7^\circ&=\frac{d}{4}\\d&=4\sin7^\circ\\d&\approx0.49\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$
